comment: Three rules. one-father-per-child is the load-bearing one: it makes the ground-truth reading of the youngest son and the household's reading of him mutually exclusive claims about the same slot, so the two are a real contradiction rather than two compatible sentences — and it does not fire, because they are held in different frames, which is exactly the shape of a house keeping something from itself. The two map rules keep the winter honest: nobody is in two rooms at once, and nobody crosses between rooms the house has no way between.
